name: AION Sovereign Brain Bootstrap
purpose: Provider-free first-run creation of an empty customer-owned AION brain bound to the canonical Boardroom Business Map
requirements_onboarding: capability recommendations from entities, locations, currencies, users, projects, collaborators, approvals, identity, regulation and compute needs; no arbitrary small/medium/large label and no automatic commercial entitlement
business_connector_onboarding: secret-free read-only status and aggregate projections for existing Files, Gmail, Calendar, CRM/Sales and Xero authorities
unified_intelligence_contract: provider-neutral request, response, stream and adapter contracts with bounded routing, external-field minimization, circuit breaking, receipts and governed delivery
signed_model_catalogue: trusted manifests, immutable artefact identity, licence and hardware preflight, public/private evaluation separation, bounded canaries, rollback, drift and revocation controls
compute_plugins: local and customer-owned compute adapters, private endpoint rules, deployment and scale recipes, replaceable attestation, accelerator profiles and provider-optional operating modes
capability_packages: signed immutable package admission, declared least authority, mandatory qualification, independent component versions, accountable activation, catalogue controls and revocation/removal
medium_business_operating_model: multi-entity groups, nested business units, locations, matrix teams, per-currency project portfolios, enterprise identity bindings, delegated approval and separation of duty, regional routing and redacted exports bound to existing Boardroom workspaces and Business Maps
governed_improvement: separate correction and verified-outcome ledgers, fresh task-class route preferences, evidence-gated automation proposals, licensed consented dataset registry, reviewed reversible model releases, elapsed retention and source-disjoint transfer promotion gates, and customer-visible reversible change records
commercial_assurance: cryptographically tenant-bound editions, content-free optional-service metering, customer-opt-in zero-content diagnostics, operational commitment contracts, plain-language ownership guarantees and an explicit external release-gate register
commercial_adoption: signed sovereign ownership entitlements, bounded department trials, verified-action accounting, separated compute funding, safe review-only fallback and private value evidence
payment_boundary: opaque vault references, exact-term approval and signature-verified idempotent provider events; no live certified provider bundled
capacity_and_migration: requirements-based compute class recommendations and staged identity-preserving whole-brain migration with source retention and rollback
core_capability_library: separately distributed signed Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance Monitoring, Operations and Field Services packs; each requires its own qualification before activation
cross_platform_installed_service: native macOS launchd payload plus unsigned Windows SCM and hardened Linux systemd developer packages; platform signing and clean-machine qualification remain release gates
aion_flow_intelligence_stack: signed provider-neutral model manifests, replaceable local/customer-cloud/provider compute, encrypted stable bindings, model-independent harnesses, minimum-necessary Business Map context, evidence packs, bounded deliberation and pre-execution governance plans
runtime_recovery: bounded health supervision with cooldown, automatic restart, failure ceiling and explicit manual-recovery state
update_system: trusted-publisher Ed25519 manifests, declared-file verification, safe staging, atomic version selection, post-start health gate, automatic rollback and mother-signed hash-chained history
update_trust_anchor: external release-signing key required before production distribution
offline_reference_bundle: qualified macOS arm64 bundle includes a verified relocatable CPython 3.13 runtime, locked binary dependency wheelhouse, Ollama arm64 runtime and Gemma 3 1B model; installation and useful local inference require no network or paid provider key
